column1: # TEST LIST, NOT AN APPROVAL. The set that tools/build/tests/functional/conda_set.sh builds,
# installs and breaks on purpose: the phase-1 libraries that have tests, no native code and
# no run-time shared library. Nothing here is a name approved for a registry (that list is
# packaging/conda/names.tsv) and nothing here is uploaded. Same columns as that list, but the
# summary may be left out (the macro derives one);
# names.bzl is generated from it by tools/build/package/gen_conda_names.sh.
